I answered Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal is on 25 November.

That date comes from Ilse's 14 October message in #north-team, and nothing posted there since has changed it. Marcus is a member of that channel. There are no Brackenwater files in the share to check the date against, so her message is the only source.
